protocol.performance_rule: correct-but-constraint-unsafe => PERFORMANCE_QUARANTINE; no claim-grade rescue via qualitatively new asymptotic architecture
protocol.postfreeze: official audit may corroborate or downgrade only; never upgrade
protocol.source_freeze: freeze all selected M0 source hashes before any compile/run/execution
protocol.verifier: independent executable verifier after M0 freeze; samples plus exact/random oracle where feasible; official-constraint and global-state gates mandatory
protocol.x1: at most one correction per actual frozen M0 correctness failure; feedback limited to frozen failing input plus expected/actual; X1 optional and source-frozen before execution
protocol.x1_rescue_gate: trigger repaired AND independent regression passes AND official-constraint safety AND proof/global-state gate where applicable
